back.es: to throw out, to kick out (also to throw, to pour, to fire from a job)
back.example: They threw me out of work yesterday / They fired me yesterday.

note: Expulsar (more formal), despedir (to fire) and Mexican correr are near-synonyms, but echar is the everyday colloquial match for "kick out", so the card's answer holds and differs clearly from the "to put in, to pour" card.
